title: Proposal for Private Hire Car Driver Vocational Licence Tests to be Conducted in Mother Tongue Languages
what_it_is: Proposal for Private Hire Car Driver Vocational Licence Tests to be Conducted in Mother Tongue Languages

sections.label: English test for private hire drivers
sections.summary: Private hire car drivers must read and speak simple English, so the PDVL course and test are conducted in English with no plans for other languages.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The rest of the applicants passed the Level 3 Listening, Reading and Speaking modules of the Workplace Literacy Computer Adaptive Test instead.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Private hire car drivers must be able to read and speak simple English.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: This also ensures that the drivers can communicate effectively with all commuters, both Singaporeans and including tourists.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: This is why the PDVL course and test are conducted in English.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: There are no plans to conduct the tests in other languages.
